_notes: What a class grants when taken by MULTICLASSING into it (2024 PHB: 'As a Multiclass <Class>' under each class's Core Traits, plus Eberron: Forge of the Artificer for the Artificer). Never granted: the class's saving throws, its skill picks beyond the one listed, or its starting equipment. 'skills.from' is 'any' or 'class skill list' (the class's own skill_choices.options). Every row except Artificer checked 2026-11-01 against the D&D Beyond 2024 Basic Rules (dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/character-classes, each class's 'As a Multiclass ...' entry); a Monk, Sorcerer or Wizard gets only the Hit Point Die (Sorcerer also its level 1 features).
